args.summary: Latest deploy v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Per the platform runbook, rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback completed successfully across all regions; service is now healthy with error rate at 0.2%. Follow-up required: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before any re-deploy. Note: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging prior to production rollout — pre-production checks should be reviewed.
args.title: checkout-api rollback from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 after health check failures

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated** — Deploy history showed the latest production deploy (v2.3.1) was unhealthy; the most recent healthy production release was v2.3.0. Live status confirmed all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) were on v2.3.1 with an 18% error rate.

2. **Rolled back** — Deployed v2.3.0 to all production regions. Rollback succeeded: checkout-api is now healthy across all regions with error rate back down to ~0.2%.

3. **Opened incident** — Filed SEV2 incident **INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback to v2.3.0, and follow-up items: root-cause v2.3.1's failure before redeploying, and note that v2.3.1-rc was already unhealthy in staging, suggesting pre-production checks should be reviewed.
